jobs.title: Data Engineer - Remote
jobs.description: About the Company The Walt Disney Company is a global entertainment organization. This position is with Disney Entertainment Operations LLC, part of The Walt Disney Company’s Corporate business. About the Role The Walt Disney Company is seeking a Data Engineer to join the Performance Marketing team within its Enterprise Media and Marketing organization. The team brings together marketers, software engineers, data scientists, and analysts to support data-driven media campaigns and marketing strategies. In this role, you will help develop campaign planning tools, data science workflows, and web applications that support paid media execution and optimization. You will build and maintain data pipelines, establish engineering standards, and work closely with media and marketing teams to turn prototypes into reliable production solutions. Key Responsibilities Contribute to the development of tools used by the Performance Marketing group. Drive data engineering, data modeling, and architectural standards across the team. Establish and maintain standards for pipeline development, observability, and documentation. Create and manage end-to-end data pipelines, connecting source systems with downstream teams, applications, and users. Collaborate with media and marketing specialists to develop prototypes and turn them into production-ready pipelines and applications. Implement quality controls, monitoring, and safeguards to ensure campaign optimizations are applied accurately and safely. Maintain the accuracy of key business metrics and data presented to users. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 3+ years of experience designing and delivering backend architectures in production environments. Strong understanding of software design patterns and engineering best practices. Experience with Spark and SQL. Experience building simple, maintainable data pipelines on scaled data platforms. Strong technical problem-solving skills and the ability to investigate complex technical components. Experience working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments and translating business needs into practical requirements. Strong understanding of how AI and large language models can be applied effectively in software development, including the ability to evaluate practical value and implement useful applications. Preferred Qualifications Experience working effectively with data science teams. Experience with the following technology stack: Spark Python Databricks or Snowflake AWS Terraform Knowledge of media buying and advertising platforms, including: Data Management Platforms (DMPs) Google Ads Facebook and Instagram Innovid LiveRamp Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs), including Google Display & Video, The Trade Desk, and Yahoo . Location & Work Arrangement This is not a remote position. Candidates must be located in the local area or be open to relocation. The listed hiring range applies to the New York City location. Compensation & Benefits Annual hiring range: $113,700–$152,400. Actual base pay will depend on internal equity, geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may also be included in the compensation package, along with medical, financial, and other benefits depending on the level and position offered. They work hands-on with code, data, and modern tools, collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions. Responsibilities include adhering to best practices, security standards, and regulatory requirements, and contributing to the innovation process by applying knowledge of market trends and industry dynamics. All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work. Interpret technical requirements and execute component designs provided by senior engineers. Create and implement code across assigned components, applying coding patterns, guidelines, and best practices. Participate in code review processes, gather feedback, and apply changes to owned aspects of code or design. Conduct unit testing and support testing code for one component in a common testing environment. Contribute to the development of tools and automation processes for transforming, managing, accessing, deploying, and monitoring data processes. Collaborate with team members to create queries, extract and compile raw data, and apply basic modification techniques to transform data. Review and escalate alerts to maintain a data pipeline, assist with investigations, and implement basic solutions to minimize failures. Follow troubleshooting guidance for reviewing, addressing, and fixing basic problems flagged by testing, and escalate complex issues as needed. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's degree, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience. Preferred Qualifications 2 or more years of work experience. Experience in attending stakeholder meetings to gather requirements. Experience in interpreting technical requirements and executing component designs. Experience in creating and implementing code across assigned components. Experience in participating in code review processes and applying feedback. Experience in conducting unit testing and supporting code testing in a common environment. Experience in developing tools and automation processes for data management. Experience in collaborating with team members to extract, compile, and transform data. Experience in reviewing and escalating alerts to maintain data pipelines. Experience in troubleshooting and resolving basic issues in data pipelines. Experience in contributing to the innovation process by applying knowledge of market trends and industry dynamics. Experience in applying coding patterns, guidelines, and best practices. Experience in using tools to investigate vulnerabilities in software code. Experience in collaborating with team members to merge data into distributed systems, products, or tools. Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program. Work Hours Varies upon the needs of the department. Travel Requirements This position requires travel 5-10% of the time. jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Vivanti Vivanti is a home for high-performing technologists who drive measurable impact for clients. Our mission is to transform businesses and build a smarter, more connected world through the power of data, cloud, and modern technology. Global enterprise leaders rely on us to design, architect, and deliver cutting-edge data and AI solutions. The Role As a Consultant, you work with full technical independence. You design and own complex pipelines and data models, work directly with client stakeholders, and help less experienced engineers grow. You are a trusted technical voice on the engagement. What you will do • Design and build complex pipelines, data models, and integrations with minimal oversight. • Turn client requirements into technical designs and estimates for your area of the work. • Work directly with client stakeholders: run working sessions, present progress, and manage expectations. • Review code and support Analysts and Associate Consultants on your team. • Improve the performance, reliability, and cost of the platforms you build. • Spot client problems we could help solve and raise them with your engagement lead. What you bring Must have • 3+ years of hands-on data engineering experience. • Production experience with SQL, Python, and Spark or dbt, plus an orchestration tool such as Airflow. • Depth in at least one cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and one data platform (Snowflake or Databricks). • Experience working directly with business or client stakeholders. • Experience reviewing code or mentoring other engineers. Nice to have • An associate- or professional-level certification such as AWS Certified Data Engineer – Associate, Google Professional Data Engineer, Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate, or SnowPro Core. If you don't have one yet, we fund it. • Experience with a second cloud or data platform. • Data pipelines for ML or AI use cases. • Prior consulting experience. How we level We level on the scope of work you have already done, not years alone. In your first call, your recruiter will share a provisional level and its salary range, and we will tell you before the final round if the level changes. • Still building independence on production work? Our Associate Consultant (L2) role may be a better fit. • Already leading a workstream or small team for a client? See our Senior Consultant (L4) role. Perks • Access to Vivanti Academy, our proprietary knowledge platform and internal training resources. • Structured mentorship and career support. • Fully funded professional certifications across major cloud and data platforms. • Regular team socials, events, interest groups, and gatherings. • Flexible hybrid schedule: choose your days at home or in the office. • Coffee, tea, and premium snacks in the office daily. Benefits • Medical coverage with 80% firm-sponsored premiums for employees and registered dependents. • 100% employer-covered dental and vision for your entire family. • $3,000 Health Reimbursement Account for out-of-pocket medical costs. • Retirement plan with a 4% company match. • 20 days of paid time off plus 10 company holidays. • Annual CitiBike membership. • Pre-tax commuter benefits. • Paid parental leave. • Group life insurance. How to apply If you want full technical ownership on client work and a path toward leading teams, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Marketing Analytics & AI
jobs.description: ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD. At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. The Role AMD is seeking a Staff Data Engineer within the Marketing Analytics team to build and operationalize the data foundation that supports advanced analytics, data science, and machine learning across Marketing. This person will lead the hands-on development of scalable data pipelines, canonical data models, and trusted, reusable datasets that enable analytical use cases—from lead and account scoring to attribution, segmentation, forecasting, and campaign optimization. The role will work closely with data scientists, analytics professionals, Marketing stakeholders, and enterprise technology teams to translate analytical requirements into reliable data solutions. Responsibilities include integrating internal and external data through APIs and other ingestion methods, engineering datasets within environments such as Snowflake or Databricks, and establishing the data workflows, quality controls, and documentation needed to support repeatable model development and ongoing machine learning operations. The Person The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineering leader who combines strong technical execution with an understanding of how data supports analytics and machine learning. They think beyond individual pipelines to build reusable data assets with consistent definitions, clear relationships, and reliable historical context. They must be comfortable working with complex, fragmented data, translating analytical needs into practical engineering requirements, and balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term maintainability and scale. They must also be a collaborative problem-solver who builds trusted relationships across business and technical teams, communicates trade-offs clearly, and brings discipline to data quality, documentation, and delivery. The ability to guide and mentor engineers while remaining closely involved in solution design and development is important to success in this role. Key Responsibilities Build and operate scalable marketing data pipelines, transforming data from internal platforms and external sources into reliable, analysis-ready and machine-learning-ready datasets within Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable cloud data environments. Develop reusable API integrations and ingestion frameworks to bring together CRM, marketing automation, digital analytics, media, event, partner, and other relevant data, with appropriate controls for incremental updates, schema changes, failures, and reprocessing. Design and maintain canonical datasets and shared data models, establishing consistent definitions, identifiers, relationships, and historical views across core marketing entities such as accounts, contacts, leads, campaigns, engagement, spend, and opportunities. Engineer datasets for machine learning and data science, partnering with data scientists to develop features, labels, and training, validation, testing, and inference datasets. Apply appropriate historical snapshots and point-in-time logic to support reproducibility and prevent data leakage. Lead hands-on engineering delivery and continuous improvement, managing priorities and dependencies, reviewing technical designs and code, mentoring engineers, and improving development practices through reusable components, automated testing, and disciplined release management. Establish data quality, observability, and operational reliability, implementing automated validation, pipeline monitoring, freshness checks, and controls for schema and data distribution changes. Troubleshoot issues and improve pipeline performance, recovery processes, and compute efficiency. Partner with Marketing, Analytics, Data Science, Sales Operations, and IT to understand business priorities, translate use cases into data requirements, and align on dataset definitions, delivery expectations, and ownership. Preferred Experience Experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, data platform development, or a related discipline, including experience leading technical projects or small engineering teams. Strong hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience developing production-grade data pipelines, transformations, and reusable engineering components. Experience with Spark or PySpark is a plus. Hands-on experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or comparable cloud data platforms, including data modeling, workload optimization, orchestration, and management of scalable analytical datasets. Demonstrated experience building API-based data integrations, including authentication, pagination, rate limits, incremental extraction, retry logic, and schema evolution, along with familiarity with file-based and other ingestion approaches. Experience preparing data for machine learning and data science workflows, including feature engineering pipelines, label generation, point-in-time-correct datasets, training and inference consistency, and reproducible dataset creation. Familiarity with feature stores and dataset versioning is preferred. Familiarity with MLOps and modern data engineering practices, including workflow orchestration, Git-based version control, automated testing, CI/CD, environment management, and the data requirements of model deployment and retraining. Experience with tools such as dbt or Airflow is a plus. Experience designing canonical data models and reusable data products, including entity resolution, deduplication, consistent data grain, historical tracking, and integration of structured and semi-structured data across multiple systems. Understanding of marketing and sales data ecosystems, including CRM, marketing automation, digital analytics, paid media, account-based marketing, events, and opportunity data, and how these sources support analytical and predictive use cases. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to translate business and analytical needs into engineering requirements, explain technical trade-offs, coordinate cross-functional delivery, and mentor technical colleagues. Academic Credentials Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related technical field. A master’s degree or equivalent advanced experience is preferred. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship. martech26 Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict. At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI. About The Role Fundamental is seeking a Forward Deployed Data Scientist - Oil & Gas, Houston to facilitate the adoption of NEXUS and collaborate with customers to address complex technical challenges with an initial focus on Houston-based Oil & Gas customers. The Data Scientist is an integral part of our FDE team, which is dedicated to driving the successful deployment of Fundamental products and proving value over legacy baselines or net new use cases. jobs.description: Responsibilities Kforce has a client that is seeking a Data Solutions Engineer in San Antonio, TX. Overview: The P&C Data & Risk organization is looking for a hands-on Data Solutions Engineer/Senior Data Analyst to support a short-term, high-priority data enablement initiative. This individual will support the Lead Advisor within P&C Risk responsible for data analytics, AI, and broader data initiatives across the organization. The immediate objective is to complete a proof of concept focused on improving access to P&C source data and making that data consumable for analytics and risk use cases. The team currently has access to portions of the data but does not have complete visibility into the source data across different domains and layers. This person will help explore what is available, understand how the data is structured and accessed, move or transform data where necessary, and ultimately create curated Snowflake views and datasets that can be consumed by the business. This is an enablement and acceleration role. The goal is to give the team additional technical capacity to move this work forward quickly while establishing a foundation that could support expanded analytics initiatives in the future.
